name: Deathclaw Meat
blurb: The Deathclaw in Fallout 76 — drops Deathclaw Meat, 51 NPC variants, 49 known spawn points.

farming_tips.spawn_note: Deathclaw Meat comes from killing Deathclaws and looting the body.

ranks.desc: 40% chance to find extra meat from animal corpses.

Food and drink weights are reduced by 45%.

Food in your inventory will spoil 45% slower.

consumption.note: Deathclaw Meat is a food consumable. It grants no timed stat buff on its own.
